title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 15: Surrender

scenes.say: VA therapy room. Ms. James sits across from Ali. He's distant.
scenes.visual: a therapy room with two chairs facing each other, soft window light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You've been through more than most. That changes people. That's okay.
scenes.visual: a counselor's notepad on her lap, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I don't need help. Then why are you here?
scenes.visual: a man sitting with arms crossed, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You can't fight your mind like it's Fallujah. You gotta surrender to healing.
scenes.visual: a box of tissues and a glass of water on a small table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I hated hearing that. But part of me knew she was right.
scenes.visual: a man looking down at his hands, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The gym. Ali hits a punching bag with fury. People glance.
scenes.visual: a man punching a heavy bag hard in a gym, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A trainer steps up. You fight? I survived.
scenes.visual: a trainer standing beside a heavy bag, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Same thing. You want a job?
scenes.visual: boxing gloves hanging on a hook, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I needed purpose. Even if it started with pain.
scenes.visual: a man wrapping his hands in a quiet gym at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Sixteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: an empty boxing ring under one light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 15 of 25: Surrender. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
